description: This file implements a QUIC client interop test tool that performs various protocol feature tests and reports supported features based on server responses. It includes functions for connection setup, request handling, feature detection, and version negotiation, with a focus on QUIC and HTTP/3 protocol features.

classes.name: QuicClientInteropRunner
classes.description: A class that manages the execution of QUIC protocol feature tests, including connection attempts, feature detection, and resumption logic.

methods.name: AttemptResumption
methods.description: Attempts to resume a session and updates features based on success.

methods.name: AttemptRequest
methods.description: Performs a full connection, request, and feature detection cycle with various protocol options.

methods.name: ConstructHeaderBlock
methods.description: Constructs HTTP/2 header block for GET request.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request and updates features based on response.
